```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# STEP 2: Compute regional BD scores ------------------------------

```{r Combine OCE_Scores0 scores}
Biomes_Combined0 <- bind_rows(HAB_Scores, OCE_Scores, ROK_Scores, SOF_Scores, RHO_Scores)
# 846 obs., 12 vars. (as of August 11 2026)

table(Biomes_Combined0$biome_type)
# coastal_dune     mangrove   open_ocean    saltmarsh     seagrass 
#          108          117           63          108           72 
# Great!

# After Aug 5:
# coastal_dune     mangrove   open_ocean   rocky_reef    saltmarsh     seagrass 
#          108          117           63           51          108           72 

# After Aug 11:
# coastal_dune      mangrove    open_ocean rhodolith_bed    rocky_reef     saltmarsh      seagrass 
#          108           117            63           152            55           108            72 
#  soft_bottom 
#          171 

# Great!
```

```{r Compute BD_score}
colnames(Biomes_Combined0)

BD_Scores0 <- Biomes_Combined0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region, biome_type, biome_score) %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region) %>%
  summarize(
    BD_score = mean(biome_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    biome_types = paste(unique(biome_type), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 195 obs., 4 vars.
```

```{r Filter out the years for which we have all habitat types}
BD_Scores<- BD_Scores0 %>%
  filter(year >= 2019, year <= 2024)
# 54 obs., 4 vars.
```


```{r Sanity check final BD_Scores}
colnames(BD_Scores)

summary(BD_Scores$BD_score)

# BEFORE rocky reefs (Aug 5):
  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
  # 61.37   67.68   72.35   73.79   80.50   86.50 

# AFTER rocky reefs (Aug 5):
  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
  # 61.37   65.30   70.18   72.00   78.31   86.50 

# AFTER RHO and SOF (Aug 11):
  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
  # 64.80   73.44   77.20   77.12   82.29   87.63 

# Year 2024 mean for BD scores:
mean(BD_Scores$BD_score[BD_Scores$year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE)
# 71 (BEFORE ROK was added, Aug 5)
# 70 (ROK pulled the score down slightly...)
# 76 (RHO and SOF pulled the scores up quite a bit...)
```

# PLOT BD_Scores  ------------------------------
```{r Load in BD_Scores as needed}
BD_Scores0 <- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/BD/BD_Scores/BD_Scores_1.0_df_Aug052026.csv")
# 56 obs., 4 vars.

BD_Scores<- BD_Scores0
```

```{r Region key}
Region_Key0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/CONAPESCA_Keys/Spatial_Keys/RegionKey_FINAL_May262026.csv")

colnames(Region_Key0)

Region_Key<- Region_Key0 %>%
  select(OHI_region= OHI_region_est, OHI_region_name) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r Merge Region_Key to BD_Scores}
BD_Scores<- BD_Scores %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, 
            by = "OHI_region")

# Make sure to order the regions:
Region_order <- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Western Central Gulf",
  "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Southeastern Gulf"
)

BD_Scores <- BD_Scores %>%
  mutate(
    OHI_region_name = factor(
      OHI_region_name,
      levels = Region_order
    )
  )
```

```{r Plot BD_Scores}
unique(BD_Scores$OHI_region_name)

Region_colors<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

BD_Scores_OverTime<- BD_Scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(OHI_region_name)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = BD_score,
    color = OHI_region_name
  )) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ OHI_region_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "BD Scores by Region [DRAFT]",
    subtitle= "updated: Aug 11 2026",
    y = "BD Score (from 0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = Region_colors) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

BD_Scores_OverTime
```
